desired_performances: Given a complex technical issue and a non-specialist audience, structure an explanation and adapt terminology to the audience.

objectives.performance: Structure an explanation of a complex technical issue for a non-specialist audience
success_criteria: Explanation follows a logical structure (e.g., problem-context-mechanism-impact)
Technical concepts are introduced in order of dependency
Key points are identifiable and appropriately emphasized

assumption_notes: Assumes learner can identify technical concepts that require adaptation
Assumes learner has baseline understanding of the technical domain being explained

objectives.performance: Adapt technical terminology to match non-specialist audience understanding
conditions: Given technical terminology in a complex issue
success_criteria: Jargon is replaced with plain-language equivalents or explained when first used
Analogies or examples are relevant to the audience's context
Level of detail matches audience's need without oversimplifying or patronizing

assumption_notes: Assumes learner can assess audience's prior knowledge level
Assumes learner has access to audience context or personas

assessments.capability_claim: Structure and adapt a technical explanation for a non-specialist audience

required_evidence.criterion: Explanation follows a logical structure with identifiable problem, context, mechanism, and impact sections
required_evidence.rationale: Directly maps to obj-tc-001 success criterion requiring logical structure

required_evidence.criterion: Technical concepts are introduced in order of dependency, with foundational concepts preceding dependent ones
required_evidence.rationale: Directly maps to obj-tc-001 success criterion on concept ordering

required_evidence.criterion: Technical jargon is either replaced with plain-language equivalents or explicitly defined at first use
required_evidence.rationale: Directly maps to obj-tc-002 success criterion on jargon handling

required_evidence.criterion: Analogies or examples are contextually relevant to the specified non-specialist audience
required_evidence.rationale: Directly maps to obj-tc-002 success criterion on audience-relevant examples

task.description: Given a complex technical issue description and a specified non-specialist audience profile, produce a written or oral explanation that structures the issue logically and adapts terminology appropriately for the audience.
conditions: Complex technical issue provided with domain-specific terminology
Non-specialist audience profile or persona provided
Time constraint of 20-30 minutes for explanation production

performance_levels: Explanation lacks clear structure; concepts are presented in arbitrary order
Explanation has partial structure; some concepts are ordered by dependency but gaps exist
Explanation follows clear logical structure; technical concepts are consistently introduced in dependency order with identifiable key points
Technical jargon is used without explanation; no evidence of audience adaptation
Some jargon is explained or replaced, but inconsistently; limited use of audience-relevant examples
Jargon is systematically addressed; analogies and detail level are well-matched to audience context without oversimplifying

scoring.mastery_rule: Both dimensions must reach the highest performance level

assumption_notes: Assumes technical issue complexity is calibrated to learner's domain knowledge per obj-tc-001 assumption
Assumes audience profile provides sufficient context for adaptation decisions per obj-tc-002 assumption
Combines both objectives into single performance task as they represent integrated capability

prerequisites.capability: Identify core technical concepts and their dependencies within a given technical issue
prerequisites.rationale: Without ability to identify which concepts are foundational vs. dependent, learner cannot sequence them logically as required by obj-tc-001 success criterion on dependency ordering

prerequisites.capability: Recognize technical jargon and domain-specific terminology in text
prerequisites.rationale: Without ability to recognize which terms are jargon, learner cannot replace or define them as required by obj-tc-002 success criterion on jargon handling

prerequisites.capability: Interpret audience profile or persona specifications to determine prior knowledge level
prerequisites.rationale: Without ability to interpret audience profile, learner cannot determine appropriate detail level or select relevant analogies as required by obj-tc-002 success criteria on audience context and detail matching

modules.title: Adapting Technical Terminology for Non-Specialist Audiences

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 addresses obj-tc-001 (structuring explanations) first because logical structure provides the scaffolding for terminology adaptation
Module 2 addresses obj-tc-002 (adapting terminology) second, building on the structured framework established in Module 1
Module 3 provides brief integrated practice combining both objectives before the summative assessment, ensuring learners can coordinate both capabilities

assumption_notes: Assumes 60-minute time budget allows approximately 25 minutes per objective-focused module plus 10 minutes for integration
Assumes prerequisite capabilities (prereq-tc-001, prereq-tc-002, prereq-tc-003) are already met or will be verified separately
Sequencing assumes obj-tc-001 (structuring) logically precedes obj-tc-002 (terminology adaptation) in instructional order
Integration module is minimal given tight time budget; deeper practice would require extended time

lessons.lesson_goal: Learn to structure technical explanations logically by identifying key points and ordering concepts by dependency
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Observe annotated examples showing how technical issues are broken into problem-context-mechanism-impact structure and how foundational concepts are sequenced before dependent ones

assumption_notes: Assumes demonstration is efficient for tight time budget
Assumes learners can transfer observed structure to new technical issues

lessons.lesson_goal: Practice structuring a technical explanation with logical sequencing and identifiable key points
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Outline a provided technical issue by identifying key points, ordering concepts by dependency, and mapping to problem-context-mechanism-impact structure with scaffolding prompts

assumption_notes: Assumes guided practice with scaffolding is appropriate before independent application
Assumes 15 minutes allows sufficient time for outlining without full explanation production

lessons.lesson_goal: Learn strategies for identifying jargon and replacing or defining it appropriately for non-specialist audiences
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Examine worked examples showing jargon identification, plain-language replacement, contextual definition, and audience-matched analogy selection with explicit decision rationales

assumption_notes: Assumes worked examples with explicit reasoning support transfer of adaptation strategies
Assumes 10 minutes allows examination of multiple terminology adaptation techniques

lessons.lesson_goal: Practice adapting technical terminology for a specified non-specialist audience
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Rewrite technical statements for a given audience profile by identifying jargon, selecting appropriate adaptations, and choosing relevant analogies without scaffolding

assumption_notes: Assumes independent practice is appropriate for apply-level objective
Assumes 15 minutes allows focused practice on terminology adaptation without full explanation production

lessons.lesson_goal: Integrate structuring and terminology adaptation by producing a brief technical explanation for a non-specialist audience
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Produce a brief technical explanation combining logical structure and audience-appropriate terminology, preparing for summative assessment

assumption_notes: Assumes 10 minutes allows brief integrated practice before summative assessment
Assumes formative use of summative assessment task provides practice with exact performance expectation
Integrated practice addresses create-level cognitive demand of obj-tc-001
